observations.body: Paul asks Corinth to bear a jealous foolishness. I wish that you would bear with me in a little foolishness, but indeed you do bear with me. But though I am unskilled in speech, yet I am not unskilled in knowledge. No, in every way we have been revealed to you in all things.

payload.posture: Read 2 Corinthians 11:1–6 as one movement in Paul's story, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states paul asks Corinth to bear a jealous foolishness. I wish that you would bear with me in a little foolishness, but indeed you do bear with me. But though I am unskilled in speech, yet I am not unskilled in knowledge. No, in every way we have been revealed to you in all things.
